name: Alpha Automotive
old_description: Leading supplier of insurance quality, reconditioned, and surplus OEM parts!
about:
Alpha Automotive LLC operates from Green Bay, Wisconsin, where it supplies insurance-quality, reconditioned, and surplus OEM parts. The business is staffed by a team with over 25 years of combined automotive experience, though the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company’s core offering is the distribution of new OEM, reconditioned, and surplus automotive parts. It maintains a one-year replacement warranty on all products and accommodates large or special orders through a quote-based process. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Alpha Automotive primarily serves the automotive repair and insurance industries, providing parts for collision repair shops, dealerships, and individual vehicle owners. The company describes its inventory as covering a range of makes and models, though specific customer names are not listed.

The company positions itself on a stress-free purchasing experience, citing knowledgeable staff and a straightforward warranty as key differentiators. It was established to address the need for reliable, insurance-grade parts with a simple replacement policy.
